Yes, that's the clearer behavior. Typing an opening quote with no closing one is just me mid-thought — I haven't finished typing yet — so having it keep showing the sensible partial matches while gently nudging me to close the quotation mark is far better than the alternatives. I wouldn't want it to suddenly throw an error and blank everything out as if I'd broken something, and I really wouldn't want it to silently hand me wrong results that look right. This way I can see it's still working with me and understand what to do to get the exact-phrase behavior.

So handling the half-typed quote calmly, with a hint rather than a scolding or a mess, is what I'd want. Happy with this.
